description: The plot illustrates the count of different types of reasoning errors across two models. The y-axis is labeled “Count” and has a linear scale ranging from 0 to 120, with tick marks every 20 units. There are five lines, each representing a different error type. The line for “Type1” is colored teal and shows a count of approximately 10 at “GPT3.5” and approximately 30 at “Mistral 7B”. The line for “Type2” is colored light orange and displays a count of approximately 20 at “GPT3.5” and approximately 30 at “Mistral 7B”. The line for “Type3” is colored lavender and has a count of approximately 0 at “GPT3.5” and approximately 120 at “Mistral 7B”. The line for “RR” is colored light blue and shows a count of approximately 40 at “GPT3.5” and approximately 30 at “Mistral 7B”. Finally, the line for “WW” is colored light green and shows a count of approximately 30 at “GPT3.5” and approximately 30 at “Mistral 7B”.
